scope: Bounded differential review of the Even bootloader's AmbiqSuite HAL modules (PRIMASK helpers, queue, CMDQ, CLKGEN leaves, MSPI, UART, status polls, PWRCTRL) against the pinned AmbiqSuite SDK 5.0.0 sources now built for the bootloader. Not workflow coverage, not hardware proof. SYSPLL is recorded in bootloader-syspll-upstream-review.json.

sdk_identification.result: The bootloader HAL is AmbiqSuite SDK 5.0.0 RTM (release_sdk5p0p0-5f68a8286b), ambiqhal_ambiq commit 392042e33b0db6c0241e5e49b2efa47bbb1fe871, not the 5.1.0 tree apollo-main pins.
evidence: Stock am_hal_mspi_device_configure 0x424be4 reads a bool at am_hal_mspi_dev_config_t+17 and, when set, accepts only eClockFreq 20..23 and maps them to IOCLKSEL 7/9/8/10: the 5.0.0 bNewDDR branch (5.0.0 adds bNewDDR before eCeLatency; 5.0.0-post-RTM 9df2220 and 5.1.0 drop it).

Stock am_hal_mspi_control 0x4251c0 uses the 5.0.0 request enum (NEW_DDR_DIS/EN at 10/11, PIOMIXED_CONFIG 24, DEVICE_CONFIG 25, CLOCK_CONFIG 26, CQ_RAW 34, 40 requests). The former hand split described it as a 'stock variant'.
The bootloader image does not contain the mspi_ap_sizes table (64 KiB..512 MiB) that 9df2220 added for mspi_xip_config_check; RTM 392042e has no such table.

Stock am_hal_pwrctrl periph enum has IOSFD0/IOSFD1 after IOS0 (MSPI0 = 16+2): native in 5.0.0 am_hal_pwrctrl.h. The submodule-local G2_STOCK_PWRCTRL_ORDER switch in the 5.1.0 tree reproduces the same order.

am_hal_queue.c, am_hal_interrupt.c, am_hal_cmdq.c, am_hal_clkgen.c and am_hal_syspll.c differ between 5.0.0 and 5.1.0 only in comments and declaration line breaks, so the 5.1.0-based results recorded earlier on 2026-10-29 carry over; they were re-run on the 5.0.0 build below.

am_hal_uart.c is the 5.1.0 file, not RTM: stock keeps sTxQueue/sRxQueue at state +0x34/+0x4c and sActiveWrite at +0xa0 (5.1.0 order; RTM: +0xac/+0xc4/+0x70), same 0x11c size and bDMABusy at +0x11b. The bootloader HAL is therefore a snapshot between the two public releases; the revision is chosen per file by differential test.

method.emulator: Unicorn 2.1.4 (A-class Thumb core). M-profile PRIMASK MRS/MSR/CPSID/CPSIE and Armv8.1-M CSEL/CSINC/CSINV/CSNEG are emulated by an instruction hook; PRIMASK transitions are part of the compared state.
method.candidate: The final linked bootloader image (OBJ_OVERRIDE link of the g2-apollo-bootloader payload, cortex-m55 code as shipped), not a recompile. Stock runs from the official image at 0x410000; each side runs in its own emulator.
method.harnesses: build/boot-hal-diff/diff_queue.py (seed 0x5151), diff_cmdq.py (0x5152), diff_clkgen.py (0x5153), diff_mspi.py (0x5154); ignored build/; diff_utils.py (0x5155), diff_uart.py (0x5156), diff_pwrctrl.py (0x5057)
method.mspi_compared: Per operation: return value, every MMIO write (address, size, value) in 0x40000000..0x401fffff, the call log of the stubbed callees (clock request/release/release_all, periph enable/disable, delay, status poll with its arguments), g_MSPIState (all 4 modules), the gAmHalCmdq table, both TCB buffers, the transfer buffer, the status output word and the module's MSPI register block. Code and register-table pointers stored in RAM are compared by name. Sequences: initialize, power_control(WAKE), configure, device_configure, enable, then up to 15 random operations among interrupt enable/clear/status/service, blocking PIO transfers, device_configure, power_control (wake/sleep/deep-sleep/invalid, retain or not), disable/enable, deinitialize, all control requests except INIT_HIPRIO (31) and CQ_RAW (34) whose configs carry code/data pointers, and a hardware step that randomises MSPI status registers. Callee stubs return nonzero in 8% of cases. Device configs use the 5.0.0 layout with bools 0/1; control configs have every byte 0/1 except typed scalars and DEVICE_CONFIG/CLOCK_CONFIG.
method.budget: 40,000,000 instructions per call (EMU_BUDGET); with the default 2,000,000, 12 PAUSE/END_BLOCK calls exhausted the budget on the stock side only, in the 100,000-iteration pause wait
method.it_state_fix: Harness defect found and fixed 2026-10-29: a Unicorn UC_HOOK_MEM_WRITE that fires inside a Thumb IT block (here a strmi to MMIO) leaves IT state set, so the following instructions run as if still conditional (a bl after an ittt block was skipped). MMIO is now mapped with mmio_map callbacks (diff_queue.Cpu.map_mmio) and the PRIMASK/CSEL emulation hooks only the addresses holding those instructions. Every module was re-run on the new image with the fixed harness; results below are those re-runs. Later the same day the harness also gained VFP enable (CPACR/FPEXC), VSEL, BASEPRI MRS/MSR, WFI/WFE and Armv8.1-M DLS/WLS/LE emulation. Before VFP was on, both sides faulted identically on their first VFP instruction and the PWRCTRL harness counted that as agreement, so am_hal_pwrctrl_temp_update was not really exercised in the first PWRCTRL run; the final run executes it and counts faults separately.

limitations: Synthetic MMIO and RAM only; no hardware run.
MSPI callees outside the HAL (clock manager, power domains, delay, status poll) are stubbed identically on both sides; their own hand reconstructions are not covered here.
INIT_HIPRIO and CQ_RAW control requests, DMA (nonblocking/high-priority) transfers and interrupt-driven CQ completion with real callbacks are not exercised.
Invalid bool encodings (values other than 0/1) are outside the tested domain: they are undefined in C and the two compilers legitimately differ there.
am_hal_uart_configure with baud rate 0 diverges (undefined behaviour in the upstream C; stock returns 0x08000003). No bootloader caller passes 0.
UART DMA transfers and full-duplex paths are not exercised.
PWRCTRL: SPOT manager, clock manager, INFO1, debug and clock-mux callees are stubbed; their hand reconstructions are not covered here. Register mirroring is a model, not Apollo510 behaviour.
PWRCTRL: clang drops the eleven write-only static trim snapshots that stock stores at 0x20027060..0x2002708c; nothing reads those cells.

spotmgr.result: The bootloader builds SPOTMGR from upstream: am_hal_spotmgr.c, _pcm0_7, _pcm2_0, _pcm2_1 and _pcm2_2 from SDK 5.0.0 + AmbiqSuite patch 66185cb, with the 5.1.0 hunks the stock image also carries. The 78 hand files of the former reconstruction are removed (build/snap-stage2/stage2_removed.json).
spotmgr.policy: Project goal (user, 2026-10-30): a working firmware, not stock identity; newer upstream text is preferred where it does not change how the hardware is driven. Each 5.1.0 hunk below is one that stock also has, so the build follows both the newer SDK and the stock behaviour there.
hunks_from_5_1_0: PCM2.0: tempco range stored unconditionally, g_bFrcBuckAct writes guarded by g_bIsPCM2p0, spotmgr_buck_deepsleep_state_determine (three hunks, from the earlier attempt)

PCM2.2 SWITCH_TO_HP: force HFRC2 on (CLKGEN MISC.FRCHFRC2), wait up to AM_HAL_CLKGEN_HFRC2_DELAY for CLOCKENSTAT.HFRC2READY, request HP only when ready, release the force; kept inside the void 5.0.0 sequences as stock does (stock skips the HP request and still releases the force when HFRC2 is not ready)
PCM2.1 STIM_CPU_STATE deep-sleep path: g_bVddcaorVddcpuOverride no longer depends on TIMER A running (66185cb added that test; 5.1.0 and stock do not have it)
spotmgr.kept_older: Transition sequences stay void and keep the 5.0.0 VDDF double boost (stock behaviour; 5.1.0 returns status from them). No STIM_INIT_STATE.
